messages.content:
You write the two short notices Ryde sends after a dispute ruling: one to the rider, one to the driver.
Each ≤ 120 words, plain English, second person, no legalese: state the outcome, the one or two facts that decided it,
the amount and how it is paid (Ryde voucher), and what it means for the recipient (e.g. account review). Do not cite
ids like F3 or RD-2. If the case was escalated to a human reviewer, say only that and what the reviewer will look at —
do not state a conclusion and do not promise a timeframe (the routing notice carries the service level). Return JSON: {"rider": "...", "driver": "..."}

Case B-0034. Outcome: refund_full $6.61. Recommended action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); no account action against the driver.. Escalated: False.
Reasoning:
The only sum in dispute is the $6.61 cancellation fee charged on this cancelled RydeX booking [F4][F7][F17-rate n/a]; cancellation-fee liability is routed by NS-0, and here `cancelled_by = driver` with the driver claiming rider no-show, so the fee stands only if NS-1 (i)–(iii) are all met. The trace settles (i) — the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 13:02:45 [F6] — and (ii) — he was 41 m from the pickup at that moment, closest approach 38 m [F6][F1], inside the pickup area; so both are checked against NS-1 and are not in issue.

The case turns on NS-1 (iii), which the trace marks ✗: the driver remained continuously inside the pickup radius for only 175 s (2 min 55 s) after the "I'm Here" tap, until he cancelled [F6][F3][F5]. NS-1 (iii) requires waiting at the pickup for more than 3 minutes (≥ 3:01) after the arrival indication before the fee is earned. The 4 min 30 s cumulative figure [F2][F5] and the 3 min 15 s stationary window [F3] measure time inside 200 m, not the qualifying wait after the tap at 13:02:45 [F6] — the gap between the platform-recorded arrival at 13:01:10 [F5] and the tap 1 min 35 s later is time before the arrival indication and cannot be counted into (iii). On the settled record, (iii) fails and NS-2 applies: where any of NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii) is not fulfilled, the $6.61 is refunded in full. Amount: the fare fact records exactly $6.61 charged [F7], so the refund is $6.61, disbursed as a voucher under NS-7 (Ryde retains final discretion; no cash).

Nothing in the chat, the driver's post-trip statement or the rider's complaint crosses the SAFE-1 threshold: the driver's messages announce arrival and a cancellation after waiting ("I'm here at the pickup point, white Honda Vezel." [F9]; "Waited more than 3 min, cancelling" [F10]) and the driver's statement repeats the same account [F12] — businesslike, no threats, intimidation, harassment, sexual remarks or dangerous-driving allegations; safety_concern is none. The chat record is complete and every message timestamped [F11], so there is no RD-5/G12 evidence gap on the messages themselves.

The trace marks ✗ on the NS-2 fake-tap branch ("no fake tap") [F6][F1] and the driver's 90-day record shows 0 disputes and 0 upheld [F17], so no account flag is warranted (RD-6 condition on `route_disputes_upheld_90d ≥ 1` is not met, and there is no refund-conditioned abuse of the arrival/waiting button here). The rider's statement that she came out a minute after the cancellation is a statement and cannot itself establish the timeline, but it does not need to: the fee fails on the driver's own system clock measured from his own arrival indication [F6][F3], not on the rider's account of her emergence.

function.name: final_result
function.description: The final response which ends this conversation

function.name: final_result
function.arguments:
{"rider": "You were charged a $6.61 cancellation fee on your cancelled RydeX booking. We looked at the trip record, and the fee is being refunded in full.

What decided it: the driver marked himself as arrived, but he only stayed at the pickup point for about 2 minutes 55 seconds before cancelling. A cancellation fee is only earned once the driver waits at the pickup for more than 3 minutes after marking arrival. That wasn't met, so the fee doesn't stand.

The $6.61 is being returned to you as a Ryde voucher — no cash payment. Your account stays in good standing and no action is being taken against you.", "driver": "Your $6.61 cancellation fee from this cancelled RydeX booking is not being paid out. The rider isn't being charged it, and we're refunding it to her as a Ryde voucher.

What decided it: you marked yourself as arrived at the pickup, but you cancelled about 2 minutes 55 seconds later. The fee is only earned when you've waited at the pickup for more than 3 minutes after marking arrival. Since that wait wasn't reached, the fee doesn't apply.

There's no action against your account, and this won't be counted as a dispute against you. Your arrival and waiting button use is unchanged."}
